Applicant :- Ahsan Pathan
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Upadhyay,Ayyaz Khan,Azhar Hussain
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the applicant had enticed the victim after hypnotized and had developed physical relation based upon the said hypnotism.
It was also alleged that due to the said hypnotism, the informant has taken away a sum of Rs.2,50,000/- and some ornaments and left the same with the applicant.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she was under the hypnotic effect of the applicant and has gone with him at Punjab.
3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

sentences.text:
Considering the nature of the allegations levelled in the FIR coupled with the fact that the victim is major aged about 18 years and has gone to Punjab with the applicant as per the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.; prima face, there is no material to suggest the scientific basis of the prosecution story with regard to the hypnotics, the applicant is in custody since 07.09.2022 and has no criminal antecedents and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
5.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ahsan Pathan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.154 of 2022, under Sections 366, 376, 506, 406 IPC, Police Station Janakpuri, District Saharanpur on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
